data.title: US, Israel face threats of war if oil prices keep rising | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: The US and Israel know that the main hurdle to keeping the lid on the war with Iran is the price of oil, and it will keep rising if no solution can be found for Hormuz and the Houthis.
